question: Does the R44CC/R44CD formula image secretly impose a graph-structural promise that could make it easier than arbitrary GRAPH_3_COLORING?
core_obligation: Construct a formula-only polynomial decoder D such that for every finite simple graph G, D(I(G)) = G exactly under canonical vertex ordering recovered from common-core blocks.

construction.block_recovery: connected components of the common-clause variable graph
construction.edge_recovery: cross-block target clauses induce the decoded interaction edges

required_properties: decoder_runs in polynomial time in formula size
encode-decode left inverse holds for every audited graph
image includes witnesses violating candidate universal promises: bipartite, planar, bounded degree, bounded treewidth, chordal
no finite audit is promoted to a universal theorem by itself; the universal left-inverse claim must also be justified symbolically
